input.summary: Send controlled shots to the two top-corner Triples horseshoes, use a same-flipper return or Dead bounce for the mirror shot, and ignore the narrow vari-targets unless a deep hit is reliable.

quickInfo.name: Autoplunger
quickInfo.summary: The machine launches each ball from between the flippers, so it has no player-controlled skill shot.

quickInfo.name: Triples horseshoes
quickInfo.summary: Each top-corner Triples horseshoe scores 3K on Home Run, while Playball uses one-tenth scoring.

quickInfo.name: Lit bumpers
quickInfo.summary: The bumpers stay lit after activation and can start the game in a lit state.

quickInfo.name: Double chutes
quickInfo.summary: The side Double chutes add useful value, but their exits can move directly toward the center drain.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target home run
quickInfo.summary: A deep vari-target hit scores a 5K home run on Home Run, while Playball uses one-tenth scoring.

steps.text: Prepare both flippers for the automatic launch from the center of the lower playfield.
Control the ball, then shoot the more reliable top-corner Triples horseshoe.
Watch the horseshoe return. Catch it on the same flipper or dead-bounce it to the opposite flipper.
Use the controlled return for the same horseshoe or its mirror shot.
Take incidental hits on a lit center bumper or a side Double chute.
Ignore the numbered runner targets during points play.
Repeat the Triples route while the top feeds remain controlled.

fallback.title: One-corner Triples loop
fallback.when: Use this plan when only one top horseshoe has a predictable feed.

steps.text: Choose the top-corner Triples horseshoe with the safer entry and return.
Shoot only that horseshoe from a controlled flipper.
Catch the return or use one dead bounce to regain control.
Repeat the same horseshoe instead of forcing the mirror shot.

alternatives.title: Deep vari-target home run
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when a forehand or backhand can push a vari-target to its deep value safely.

steps.text: Trap the ball and choose the vari-target with the cleaner angle.
Make one controlled shot that can reach the home-run value.
Prepare for a direct target rebound or a side-chute feed.
Return to the Triples horseshoes if the shot does not reach the deep value safely.
Identify the safer top-corner horseshoe.
Learn whether its return stays on one flipper or crosses safely.
Use a dead bounce when it produces a controlled mirror shot.
Repeat the top route and accept incidental bumper or Double-chute value.

playfieldReferences.label: Top horseshoe
playfieldReferences.description: The upper horseshoe used for triples and controlled opposite-side returns.

playfieldReferences.label: Vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: The variable-depth target used for the home-run value.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Watch the complete horseshoe feed. Let a suitable return dead-bounce to the other flipper, then shoot the opposite top corner.

techniques.name: Controlled vari-target shot
techniques.instruction: Use a forehand or backhand only when it can push the vari-target deep enough for the home-run value. Stop after an unsafe rebound.

cautions.issue: A ball that exits a side Double chute at the wrong speed can drain through the center.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the exit. Do not chase a Double chute from an uncontrolled ball.

cautions.issue: Balls can drain beside a vari-target chute or rebound sharply from the target face.
cautions.response: Ignore the vari-targets unless a controlled forehand or backhand can reach the deep value.

cautions.issue: The center autoplunger returns the ball without a normal plunger-lane pause.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready before each ball enters play. Observe the launch feed before planning the first shot.

input.simpleOverview: Playball and Home Run launch each ball automatically and reward repeat shots through the two top-corner Triples horseshoes. Find the safer horseshoe, learn whether it returns to the same flipper or crosses, and repeat that route instead of forcing a narrow vari-target.
input.overview: Playball and Home Run center on two top-corner Triples horseshoes, with bumper, Double-chute, and deep vari-target value around them. Identify the safer horseshoe and use its same-flipper or cross-playfield return to set up the mirror shot. Accept incidental upper scoring, but avoid forcing the Double chutes or vari-targets until their feeds are proven.
